name: Cisco Systems

os_families.name: Cisco IOS XE
os_families.version_scheme: MAJOR.MINOR.MAINT[letter], e.g. 17.9.4a (show version zero-pads: 17.09.04a). 16.x and 17.x trains; each release carries a codename in sysDescr.

sysdescr: Cisco IOS Software [Cupertino], Catalyst L3 Switch Software (CAT9K_IOSXE), Version 17.9.4a, RELEASE SOFTWARE (fc3)

config_model.summary: Changes take effect immediately in the running configuration. They are lost at reload unless they are copied to the startup configuration (NVRAM).
config_model.summary_ar: التغييرات تسري فورًا على الإعداد الجاري (running) وتضيع عند إعادة التشغيل ما لم تُنسخ إلى إعداد الإقلاع (startup / NVRAM).
config_model.notes: `reload in 5` before a risky change reloads the switch back to the saved startup configuration unless you cancel it; do not save until the change is verified.

os_families.cli_style: Modal CLI (user EXEC, privileged EXEC, global config, interface config). Unique prefixes are accepted (`sh int gi0/1`). In configuration mode put `do` in front of a show command. Filters: `| include`, `| section`, `| begin`.
os_families.cli_style_ar: واجهة أوامر متعددة الأوضاع (User ثم Privileged ثم Global config ثم Interface). تُقبل الاختصارات الفريدة (`sh int gi0/1`). داخل وضع الإعداد ضع `do` قبل أمر show. الفلترة: `| include` و`| section` و`| begin`.

os_families.name: Cisco IOS (classic)
os_families.version_scheme: MAJOR.MINOR(BUILD)TRAIN+REV, e.g. 15.0(2)SE11 (train SE = Catalyst 2960/3560/3750; M = mainline; T = technology).

sysdescr: Cisco IOS Software, C2960 Software (C2960-LANBASEK9-M), Version 15.0(2)SE11, RELEASE SOFTWARE (fc3)

config_model.summary: Changes take effect immediately in the running configuration. They are lost at reload unless they are copied to the startup configuration (NVRAM).
config_model.summary_ar: التغييرات تسري فورًا على الإعداد الجاري (running) وتضيع عند إعادة التشغيل ما لم تُنسخ إلى إعداد الإقلاع (startup / NVRAM).
config_model.notes: Classic IOS (the EVE-NG vIOS / vIOS-L2 lab images): `configure replace` needs the archive feature on some releases; the simplest rollback is not saving and reloading.

os_families.cli_style: Modal CLI, same style as IOS XE: user EXEC, privileged EXEC, global config, interface config; unique prefixes accepted; `do show ...` inside configuration mode.
os_families.cli_style_ar: واجهة متعددة الأوضاع بنفس أسلوب IOS XE؛ تُقبل الاختصارات الفريدة، و`do show ...` داخل وضع الإعداد.

os_families.name: Cisco NX-OS
os_families.version_scheme: MAJOR.MINOR(MAINT)[letter], e.g. 10.3(3) or 9.3(10)F; 'F' suffix marks a feature/long-lived release variants.

sysdescr: Cisco NX-OS(tm) n9000, Software (n9000-dk9), Version 9.3(10), RELEASE SOFTWARE Copyright (c) 2002-2022, Cisco Systems, Inc.

config_model.summary: Changes take effect immediately in the running configuration. They are lost at reload unless they are copied to the startup configuration (NVRAM).
config_model.summary_ar: التغييرات تسري فورًا على الإعداد الجاري (running) وتضيع عند إعادة التشغيل ما لم تُنسخ إلى إعداد الإقلاع (startup / NVRAM).
config_model.notes: NX-OS checkpoints give a real rollback point; many protocols must be enabled first with `feature <name>`.

os_families.cli_style: IOS-like modal CLI, but most protocols must be enabled first with `feature <name>`; interfaces are named `Ethernet1/1`; `show running-config | section <x>`.
os_families.cli_style_ar: شبيهة بـIOS لكن يجب تفعيل معظم البروتوكولات أولًا بـ`feature <name>`؛ الواجهات باسم `Ethernet1/1`؛ و`show running-config | section <x>`.

os_families.name: Cisco IOS XR
os_families.version_scheme: MAJOR.MINOR.MAINT, e.g. 7.5.2 (service provider routers: ASR 9000, NCS, 8000).

sysdescr: Cisco IOS XR Software (Cisco NCS-5500), Version 7.5.2

config_model.summary: Changes are staged in a target configuration and become active (and persistent) only on commit.
config_model.summary_ar: التغييرات تُجمَّع في إعداد مرشّح ولا تصير فعّالة ودائمة إلا عند `commit`.

os_families.cli_style: Two-stage CLI: edit the target configuration, then `commit`; `show configuration` lists uncommitted changes; interfaces are named like `GigabitEthernet0/0/0/0`.
os_families.cli_style_ar: أوامر على مرحلتين: عدّل الإعداد المرشّح ثم `commit`؛ `show configuration` يعرض التغييرات غير المُلتزَم بها؛ أسماء الواجهات مثل `GigabitEthernet0/0/0/0`.

syslog.example: %LINK-3-UPDOWN: Interface GigabitEthernet1/0/1, changed state to down
%LINEPROTO-5-UPDOWN: Line protocol on Interface GigabitEthernet1/0/1, changed state to down
%ETHPORT-5-IF_UP: Interface Ethernet1/1 is up in Layer3

syslog.regex: %PM-4-ERR_DISABLE:\s*(?P<cause>[\w\-]+) error detected on (?P<interface>\S+),\s+putting \S+ in err-disable state
syslog.example: %PM-4-ERR_DISABLE: bpduguard error detected on Gi1/0/5, putting Gi1/0/5 in err-disable state

syslog.regex: %SW_MATM-4-MACFLAP_NOTIF:\s*Host (?P<mac>[0-9a-f.]+) in vlan (?P<vlan>\d+) is flapping between port (?P<interface>\S+) and port (?P<interface2>\S+)
syslog.example: %SW_MATM-4-MACFLAP_NOTIF: Host 0011.2233.4455 in vlan 10 is flapping between port Gi1/0/1 and port Gi1/0/2
%SPANTREE-5-ROOTCHANGE: Root Changed for vlan 1: New Root Port is GigabitEthernet1/0/1. New Root Mac Address is 0011.2233.4455
%OSPF-5-ADJCHG: Process 1, Nbr 10.0.0.2 on GigabitEthernet0/1 from FULL to DOWN, Neighbor Down: Dead timer expired
%CDP-4-DUPLEX_MISMATCH: duplex mismatch discovered on GigabitEthernet0/1 (not half duplex), with SW2 GigabitEthernet0/2 (half duplex).
%CDP-4-NATIVE_VLAN_MISMATCH: Native VLAN mismatch discovered on GigabitEthernet0/1 (1), with SW2 GigabitEthernet0/2 (10).
%SYS-5-CONFIG_I: Configured from console by admin on vty0 (10.0.0.5)

notes: Catalyst/Nexus are the largest installed base in enterprise LAN and DC. IOS XE and NX-OS commands differ in a few places (see os overrides).
